name: insight-flow
description: A workbench for AI-assisted task lifecycle management — CLI plus a self-contained server-rendered dashboard

scripts.build: tsup && rm -rf dist/sounds && cp -r src/server/sounds dist/sounds

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run sync-roles && npm run build && npm run typecheck
